Name: Abigail Portrait With Subtle Bow and More Accurate Bow Sprites
Author: Androxilogin
Description:
[b][UPDATE -2]  05/28/2021

I uploaded a version previously that was somehow missing the portrait changes. I'm guessing I left a layer unchecked while saving in Photoshop before compressing and uploading. I've just added this. I'm just getting back in the swing of things, sorry about that!

[/b]I've [b]FINALLY [/b]gotten around to updating this mod after about 5 years hiatus now! This version adds the new sprites that were added to the game since version... 1.2? I've also fixed up the existing sprites a bit to make her appearance a little better. Enjoy!

[b][OLD NEWS][/b]

As shown in the pictures, Abby's portrait reworked to look a little more accurate. Nothing special, but just to see the bow in her portrait and I was satisfied. Extract the .zip to your Contents directory, back up your originals if need be.

This mod was supposed to be just the portraits but I started working at jackablade's version of Abigail and couldn't stop til I felt it was right. I was originally just going to keep it for myself as a personal copy but I wanted to keep it all together.

I give [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/29946775]jackablade[/url] ([b]Stephen Schulze) [/b]most credit for the sprites in his mod, [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/212]Abigail face tweak[/url]. The base sprites were his for the character sprites, I just added to them along with using the original sprites by ConcernedApe. And also, [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/21877479]HyperChicken01[/url] for making me realize her bow was in the wrong spot then causing me to suddenly notice the whole layout was backwards everywhere.

At the bottom of the uploads page it asks if it's okay for users to upload files and all of that but I'm not sure where to find where in the mods of others that it specifies what their views are on this and I couldn't message the author to ask for permission. I've given credit so hopefully that's okay.
